text.tspan: Share of children achieving minimum reading proficiency by the end of
Share of children who achieve minimum reading proficiency by the end of lower secondary education. This data accounts
for school completion rates to estimate skills for all children, not just those in school.

tspan.tspan: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026); World Bank (2026)
